name: _template
description: Pack skeleton. Copy this directory and fill it in, or generate everything with flow_scaffold_pack.
_applets: One entry per tool. The key is a slug of your own; what matters is appletId.

my-tool.description: What it produces, in one line
my-tool._generateButton: Exact text of the action button, as shown in the UI. Get it from flow_inspect_controls, not from the code.
my-tool._controls: label is the text preceding the value in the control; current is the default value.
my-tool._vocabulary: Valid values for each dropdown, extracted from the applet's constants.ts.
my-tool._disabledActions: Actions that start disabled. If it includes the generate button, the applet needs a prior input and isn't automatable yet.
